statement: A reading preserves its subject declarations and exposes the information required by its model, numeric policy and consumer operation. Missing inputs remain named; no reading creates authority or a second cell.
classification: Design obligations grounded in existing contracts; not a new mathematical uniqueness law
acceptance: Compose admitted public functions and existing finite fixtures, retaining ids and unmeasured statuses; no new public schema validator or estimator
